does: Copies a roll record: the roll's definition and flags, then its result (through CopyStatsRollResult) and its metadata.

evidence.says: the return chain of the Result writes at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0xE75F73/bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0xE75F7F passes bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0xF1889D; called from esv::RollSystem::RollDice (bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x32961CE) with the request's Roll (+0xA8)
The writes of a roll request's result return through bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0xF1889D inside this function
The name is ours: the Toolkit exports no function of this name and the macOS build's symbols hold none; it stands in the namespace of the functions that call it.
